name: Foreign Employee Work Permit (Kafala Sponsorship)

requirements.blocker_text: Requires sponsorship (kafala) by a Kuwaiti-registered employer holding a valid commercial license and registered with the Public Authority for Manpower (PAM), in good standing with PAM, the Ministry of Social Affairs and Labour (MOSAL), and the Public Institution for Social Security (PIFSS). The employer must also have available quota under sector-specific Kuwaitization limits (minimum proportions of Kuwaiti nationals per sector).
requirements.fix_path: Secure a job offer from a PAM-registered Kuwaiti employer with available Kuwaitization quota.

requirements.blocker_text: Attested educational certificates, police clearance, and a medical exam are required, and per Ministerial Circular No. 1 of 2025, the job title/qualifications must match the applicant's verified credentials at initial hiring -- post-hire changes to job title or qualifications are restricted.

outcome.duration_length: work permit valid up to 3 years, renewable; residency permit (Iqama) requires annual renewal

sources.title: Playroll (private global-employment/EOR guide) -- Kuwait kafala work-permit system: PAM/MOSAL/PIFSS employer registration, Kuwaitization sector quotas, work permit valid up to 3 years, Iqama annual renewal (KWD 20 fee plus KWD 130 mandatory health insurance for standard expatriates), and Ministerial Circular No. 1 of 2025 restricting post-hire job-title changes
